answer: Agents commit to a hash of their next action before revealing it, creating an auditable thread of intent. A sybil attacker controlling multiple identities from the same stake knoll must pre-commit all contradictory actions. When the reveal phase exposes the inconsistency, the protocol slashes their bonded collateral. This transforms a validator garden into a self-policing ecosystem: honest agents earn rewards while defectors lose capital, because the commitment-reveal mechanism binds each identity to a single truthful action.
